identity.title: Verify external asset identification and explicit reconnection

origin.kind: scheduled 2D task execution and source review
origin.summary: 2D-020 requires moved, missing, damaged, and same-name external assets to be distinguished before a Recipe is reopened or adopted on another machine.

state.current_summary: The existing review-bundle and qualification owners already provide the required asset safety boundary. A focused isolated contract now proves missing, SHA-matched relocation, same-name content mismatch, explicit copy/save, source-byte preservation, and qualified working-copy hash ownership; no duplicate bundle or snapshot implementation was added.

objective.summary: Verify 2D-020 against the current asset review and qualification implementations and preserve the smallest explicit reconnection workflow.
constraints: Reuse OpenVisionRecipeReviewBundleExporter, OpenVisionRecipeReviewBundleInspector, OpenVisionRecipeDependencyReviewService, QualifiedRecipeSnapshotPreflight, QualifiedRecipeSnapshotStore, and QualifiedRecipeSnapshotWorkingCopyService.
Do not add a second asset bundle, recursive replacement search, silent same-name adoption, or automatic Preview/Run.
Use only isolated fixtures and D:\OpenVisionLab-TestData\OpenVisionLab_Dev evidence; do not modify user assets or C:\Git\2D\Original.
Do not commit, push, release, deploy, or perform external communication.

criteria.text: The existing bundle path distinguishes Found, RelocationCandidate, Missing, and ContentMismatch, and dependency review identifies the affected Step and parameter while keeping unresolved states blocking.

A relocation candidate is not auto-applied. After an explicit XML path decision, the existing copy/save path adopts the verified bytes into a data-relative Recipe path, preserves the source, changes the saved Pipeline content hash, and does not execute Preview/Run.
The existing qualification path rejects missing or SHA-mismatched dependencies, archives/verifies dependency bytes, and restores them only through a verified new working copy.
Debug and Release smoke builds and focused/regression contracts pass, including the existing qualification smoke.
Stable contract, current handoff, smoke dispatch, owner/call path, reading order, evidence, and remaining runtime/UI boundaries are recorded for the next scheduled slice.

context.location: Review bundle exporter writes the path/size/SHA manifest; inspector classifies path states; dependency review owns Step/parameter rows and explicit copy; qualification preflight/store/working-copy own archived dependency verification and new-Recipe restoration.

Review bundle selection -> TryInspect -> dependency review -> explicit XML path update -> copyDependencies/import -> VisionPipelineStorage.Save; qualified portability is snapshot preflight -> store archive/verify -> working-copy restore.

Missing/relocation/content-mismatch states remain blocking; dry review never rewrites XML, copies assets, imports, or runs Preview/Run. Qualified working copies are new Recipes and do not inherit qualification or Run History.

Isolated source/in-process contracts and qualification smoke passed. Desktop WPF/EXE click path, rendered candidate confirmation, ACL/read-permission failure, themes/layouts/DPI/input, hardware, field qualification, release/publication, and Original repository remain unverified or out of scope.
